symptom: mendixlabs/mxcli#1623 (ako/mxcli#1555): `describe module M with all` → `exec` of a module holding an import mapping over an XML schema printed 'Modified import mapping' and left the mapping with XsdRootElementName "" (CE0270 'No root element could be found in the schema') and an empty XmlPath on every element — re-executing the mapping's own description
cause: MDL states only `with xml schema M.S`; exec has no XSD reader, so buildImportMappingElementModel never sets XmlPath (only the message-definition builder does) and fabricates JsonPaths, and both mapping writers hardcoded XsdRootElementName "". The root was also INVISIBLE: gen bound the SDK name RootElementName instead of the storage key XsdRootElementName (it sat in keyaudit's knownWrongKeys), so nothing could have noticed it being deleted
file: mdl/executor/mapping_xml_schema_guard.go (new), mdl/executor/cmd_import_mappings.go + cmd_export_mappings.go (wired after the SOAP check), modelsdk/gen/{import,export}mappings/types.go (STORAGE-NAME OVERRIDE, struck from keyaudit), model/types.go (RootElementName on both mapping types), mdl/backend/modelsdk/mapping_{read,write}.go
fix: A create-or-modify of an existing XML-schema mapping that stores a root or any XmlPath: if the statement deep-equals the parsed description of the stored mapping (folder/doc/@excluded omissions normalised to 'keep'), report Unchanged and write nothing; otherwise refuse naming the root and the number of element paths. Mappings with no stored XML state (what mxcli writes) rewrite as before. Writers now write the model's RootElementName
insight: **Before trusting a guard on a stored value, check the reader can see it**: the first probe read root="" from a unit holding XsdRootElementName "Order" — gen's known-wrong key. mxbuild's own assemblies settle storage names without Studio Pro: Mendix.Modeler.Integration.dll carries `<StorageName> … SdkName <sdkName>` pairs in its metadata (python byte search), which is how XsdRootElementName/rootElementName and the XmlSchema entry's storage `$Type` XmlSchemas$XmlSchemaContents (list key SchemaContentss; SDK name XmlSchemaEntry) were confirmed — a planted XmlSchemas$XmlSchemaEntry crashes mx with TypeCacheUnknownTypeException. **A planted XML schema is NOT a usable oracle for XML mappings**: with the right type and keys it loads at 0 errors alone, but any mapping over it is CE0271 'The selected source is not valid' under 9 variants (no XML declaration, absolute/file/http Location, target namespace, '{0}' location format, bogus root, root-only mapping, JsonPath kept) — so the XML-element shape cannot be measured here; the evidence is the stored BSON byte-identical after replay (pre-fix: root and 5 XmlPaths emptied). The 'microflow key becomes find … or create' (CE0250) half did NOT reproduce: an XML mapping with `by MF(Key: parent)` replayed kept ObjectHandling Custom even pre-fix. Unverified lead for whoever has the stored document: the reader recovers a handler parameter's source from JsonValueElementPath only, and by the JSON corpus's own rule ('only an explicit value path is JSON-only') an XML value path would sit in XmlValueElementPath with the JSON one empty — which sourceFromStoredPath's default arm reads as `parent`
